---
name: World / scenery contribution
about: Propose a prop, room or connected area for the voxel landscape
title: "[World] "
---

## Area or object

- Working name / area ID:
- Sketch, visual reference or screenshot:
- Proposed coordinates, size and links to other areas:
- Player purpose: scenery, landmark, station or mission objective?

## Geometry and navigation

Which paths, spawn points or exits are affected? Include collision footprints and any required change to walkable bounds. The current renderer and collision definitions are separate.

## Interactions

Station IDs, expected behavior, related objectives and server-state dependencies. Mark new behaviors that do not exist yet.

## Asset and performance plan

Block-built or external assets? State the source/license, expected complexity, mobile needs and 2D alternative. Binary models and nested asset folders currently need build-pipeline work.

## Small first PR and acceptance criteria

What bounded piece could be reviewed independently, and how will someone test that paths and stations remain usable?
